sloka: तदहं स्वेन रूपेण रजन्यां ह्रस्वतां गतः ।लङ्कामभिपतिष्यामि राघवस्यार्थसिद्धये ॥५-२-४६॥
transliteration: tadahaṁ svena rūpeṇa rajanyāṁ hrasvatāṁ gataḥ ।laṅkāmabhipatiṣyāmi rāghavasyārthasiddhaye ॥5-2-46॥

translations.english: 'Therefore I shall transform myself into a tiny form and jump about the city of Lanka during night time in order to accomplish Raghava's purpose.
